Use this shard to arcanize the ring in your upper slot.

This type of shard kills a foe at the end of its turn once that foe reaches the highest degree of Moleculation. Bosses lose [1]% of their maximum Hit Points instead of dying.

Does not stack with identical shards.

A foe that reaches the highest degree of Moleculation collapses and dies at the end of its turn. Bosses lose [1]% of their maximum Hit Points instead.

Does not stack with identical shards.

Use this shard to arcanize the weapon equipped in your main hand. If no melee weapon is equipped, the ranged weapon in your main hand will be arcanized instead.

This type of shard Slows for [3] turns any target that takes [1] and fails a Strength Saving Throw ([2]). Triggers no more than once per attack.

Bosses can avoid this with a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC.

Stacks with identical shards.

A foe struck by this weapon's [1] must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw ([2]) or become Slowed for [3] turns.

Triggers no more than once per attack.

Bosses can avoid this with a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC.

Stacks with identical shards.

Use this shard to arcanize the boots you have equipped.

This type of shard gives foes affected by your Moleculation within [1] Disadvantage on Strength Saving Throws.

Does not stack with identical shards.

Foes affected by the wearer's Moleculation within [1] have Disadvantage on Strength Saving Throws.

Does not stack with identical shards.
